property_summary: For any player who locks a guess and calls settle after the target block has scrolled beyond the 256-block blockhash window (so the winning answer is keccak256 of bytes32(0)), the contract pays out the 2-ether prize and its balance drops to 0; the mutant deletes the transfer so the balance stays at 2 ether.
change_summary: Delete the payout transfer so a correct guess no longer pays out.
